meta.duty: A notifiable disease must be reported to DEFA the moment it is suspected - not confirmed. Failing to report one is a criminal offence. If in any doubt, phone DEFA.
meta.fullListNote: DEFA highlights the diseases below as the current watch list. The full statutory list of notifiable diseases is maintained by DEFRA; a link is on the gov.im page.

watchList.name: Avian Influenza (bird flu)
watchList.signs: Sudden death, swollen head, dullness, drop in egg or feed intake, respiratory distress.

watchList.name: Bluetongue
watchList.affects: Cattle, sheep, goats, deer, alpacas and llamas
watchList.signs: Fever, drooling, swelling of the head and neck, lameness, drop in milk yield. Spread by biting midges.

watchList.name: Foot and Mouth Disease
watchList.signs: Blisters on the mouth, tongue, feet and teats; lameness; drooling; reluctance to feed.

watchList.name: Chronic Wasting Disease
watchList.signs: Progressive weight loss, behavioural change, excessive drooling and thirst. Flagged for anyone importing.
